# Naver Blog

> Naver Blog is the primary platform for creating, managing, and sharing personal blogs within the Naver ecosystem.

Naver Blog (blog.naver.com) serves as the central hub for Korean users to establish and maintain personal blogs with integrated social networking features. The platform emphasizes user onboarding, account setup, and community connection through a streamlined initialization process.

## Key Topics

- Naver Blog
- blog.naver.com
- Blog Setup
- Account Creation
- Blog ID Registration
- Profile Setup
- Category Selection
- Neighbor Connection
- Onboarding Flow
- Naver Account

## Getting Started

- [Naver Blog](https://section.blog.naver.com/): Naver Blog homepage and main entry point for blog creation and setup
